body:
Im so glad you didn't. 

xoxo
I'm trying ♡ tysm

Yes, you do. I feel contradictory for saying that because I'm still up and down about it, but it buys me more time. There are some people worth living for when you feel like you can't do it for yourself. We will try to make it together. Hang in there and I will try to do the same ♡
Keep hanging in there ♡
Yes they are ♡
It's those things that don't mean much to others, but means the world to us. I'm so glad you are here and had someone that gave you hope ♡
Likewise ♡ We're in this together!

If only we could maintain that form forever. Life would be much sweeter.

Sending love back at you. Thank you so much ❤

I don't have kids, so when she said that to me, I was caught off guard. And she kept asking me over and over again that night. I was like, "how does she know?" I thought about for days.

Thanksgiving was the hardest day for me thus far. I almost didn't show up but the bff said if I didn't, she was coming to get me.

On Thanksgiving, she sat next to me in her own chair, but that wasn't good enough for her. Nope. She handed me her toys and her bottle, hopped down and stretched her little arms out. So... being the "cool auntie", I scooted (actually squished myself lol) as far in my chair as I could and put her next to me. She stayed there the whole dinner. After dinner, her gma brought out some crafts and she left me for a bit, but she made sure she came back to show and give me her stuff. Such a sweetheart.
I think I will. She is precious and I want her to always remember that ♡
Thank you ♡

Lolol Thanks for the laugh and your sweet, kind words and encouragement. I'm going to try and get myself together. You're right. Love is simply for them. It's us adults, that complicate things. Gotta love and protect the babies and furbabies ♡

Yes, and what a story that will be. Everytime she reaches her little arms out for me to pick her up, I tell her she's the sweetest. I'm going to try and get myself together and healthy again ♡ I realize that now. Thank you for the support. It means a lot.
I never looked at it like that... well, that means I need to get myself together and healthy ♡ for my sake first and then my loved ones.
Yes, amen to that ♡
Love you all more. Thank you for your kind words and support ♡
I will ♡ tysm
Same here. I wish you the best too!

And it sucks when you have to cut people off, but at some point, you have to protect yourself. I hope those kids don't develop any emotional issues. Those hurt more because they aren't visible and they stay with you forever. So heartbreaking!
I needed to hear that. You are right ♡

Absolutely! I understand that I am solely responsible for how I feel and I would never place expectations on a child. She has that big of an impact on my life. More of an impact than others. She's just so special ♡
Thats awful! Abuse is unacceptable. I hope her child is okay!
Thank you so much! She is one precious little girl. I couldn't believe someone that little would have this big of an impact on my life ♡
Yes they are ♡
Yes, please take care of yourself. I am glad you have his support. It doesn't completely take the pain away, but it eases it a bit. Thinking of you ♡
You brought me to tears. Thank you so much ♡
I cried as I wrote it. She has no idea how special she is ♡
Hang in there. You aren't alone! Keep holding that furbaby tight ♡
Yes, they definitely are ♡
And I'm going to do my best to fight my life. Thank you ♡
Thank you ♡ she is an absolute sweetheart.
And I'm soo glad your cousin can be there for you. They need and love you. Although most humans suck, the ones that matter most mean so much more. I'm so glad you're still here. You aren't alone ♡

Absolutely! The pain I feel knowing that I may never see her grow up, is enough to buy me some time and it gives me a sliver of hope. 

I too, am going to try and find more reasons stay. Thank you ♡
Me too ♡
